facts.fact: POTRAZ's acting CIRT and enforcement manager says POTRAZ established a Computer Incident Response Team to identify, manage and respond to computer security incidents in the country.

POTRAZ's advocacy and compliance manager says cyber offences are contained in the Criminal Law (Codification and Reform) Act Chapter 9:23 as amended by the Cyber and Data Protection Act (Chapter 12:07) of 2021, with no stand-alone cybercrimes Act.
Police say their cyber laboratory has resulted in several convictions involving false transmission of messages meant to cause harm nationally; no dates given.

A POTRAZ data protection unit director refers to the Cyber and Data Protection Act (Chapter 12:07), of 2021, as the law governing cyber and data protection, to be enforced under the National Development Strategy Two.

ZWE.note: Only a hope for a national ICT policy and an NDS2 priority; no sector policy stated as adopted.
The 82.87% (2025) is POTRAZ's internet penetration rate, a regulator figure, noted and not used.

facts.fact: ICT Minister Tatenda Mavetera says government is applying legal frameworks to arrest people spreading misinformation, disinformation and fake news; police report several convictions for false transmission of messages.
